title: A canceled delegation's session stays registered (idle) with its runtime working in the worktree, so `git worktree remove` of that clean worktree fails with "Permission denied"
outcome: A canceled delegation's session stays registered (idle) with its runtime working in the worktree, so `git worktree remove` of that clean worktree fails with "Permission denied"
acceptance: After termal_cancel_session returns canceled for a delegation, the child's runtime process (and any process it started) no longer holds the child's working directory open within a bounded time, so `git worktree remove` of a clean worktree succeeds (Windows test or a documented, verified procedure).
If the host cannot release the directory, the cancel result or the session state says so explicitly (which process or handle remains) instead of reporting a plain "canceled".
